verdict.rationale: RUN's own docs show employees are paid by direct deposit instead of checks: pay is automatically deposited into each employee's account on payday, and new hires enter their own direct-deposit details during onboarding. Nothing in the pack documents the fast-funding element of the story, so only half of it is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented next-day or 2-day direct deposit timing or processing lead times, and independent or hands-on corroboration of deposit speed.
